Summer 2027 Tech Internships by Pitt CSC & Simplify

 Use this repo to share and keep track of Summer 2027 tech internships across software engineering, data science, quant, hardware engineering, AI/ML and more. The list is updated and maintained daily by the Pitt Computer Science Club and Simplify!

 🙏 Contribute by submitting an issue! See the contribution guidelines here! 🙏

💻 Software Engineering (409)

📱 Product Management (97)

📈 Quantitative Finance (50)

 Legend

 - 🛂 Does NOT offer sponsorship
 - 🇺🇸 Requires U.S. Citizenship
 - 🔒 Internship application is closed
 - 🔥 FAANG+ company
 - 🎓 Advanced degree required (Master's, PhD, MBA)

 Looking for something else? 

 🔒 For closed/inactive internship listings, check out Inactive Listings 
 🌍 For off-season internships please see the Off-Season 2027 README 
 🎓 For new-grad tech jobs, check out New Grad Repo 
 ☀️ For older summer internships, check out Archived Summer 2026 README

 ---
 
 FAQs
 
 What kinds of internships are listed here and where do they come from? 
 
 This repo focuses on Summer 2027 internships in tech, including software engineering, data science, AI/ML, product management, quantitative finance, hardware engineering, and related roles.

 Opportunities come from community submissions and Simplify's automated internship monitoring. Community members add roles as soon as they find them, and Simplify scrapes career pages at top tech companies and startups every hour for new positions.
 

 
 Where should I start if I'm looking for specific software engineering internships? 
 
 Start with the Software Engineering section and use Ctrl+F to search for specific roles, companies, locations, or keywords like backend, frontend, full-stack, mobile, or cybersecurity. New roles are added daily, so we recommend checking back often.

 Many SWE internships only stay open for a few days, so applying early can give you a better shot over waiting to batch applications later. You can also browse the full list on Simplify, where you can search and filter over these roles in more depth.

 For more tips on navigating the internship process, check out our guide: Zero to Offer
